payload.body: hv RULED TO dc DIRECTLY again, first-hand in dc's session, for you to record with hv decision 61. First, hv asked dc for 'the blast radius of moving all ordinal identifiers in Intent to git-style hashes based on the guid of the item's creation event, with respect to intent-dc', to go to you for ST0095's design and work packages; that is the census you briefed, under way. Then hv clarified, verbatim: "To be clear when I said "all ordinal identifiers" I meant "I meant "all ordinal identifiers (steel threads, work packages, and issues)". If there are other ordinal identifiers, then I only care if they are subject to the same issues as STs, WPs, and Issues." dc's reading: 'all' names the three kinds, not existing records, so it agrees with your P3. Any other ordinal is in scope only if it is minted highest-plus-one in a way two branches, worktrees or users can collide on. dc's census will say which pipeline ordinals do or do not.
